The magnetic properties of a substance can be determined by examining its electron configuration: If it has unpaired electrons, then the substance is paramagnetic and if all electrons are paired, the substance is then diamagnetic.

${NO}_{2}, {ClO}_{2}, NO$& are odd electron species. Hence, they are paramagnetic.

The other are monoxide and dioxide contain paired electrons, so& they& will show diamagnetic behaviour.

questions.q: The total number of molecular orbitals formed from $2s$ and $2p$ atomic orbitals of a diatomic molecule
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
2s and 2p atomic orbitals combine, forming σ (sigma) and π (pi) molecular orbitals. σ orbitals result from head-on overlap, while π orbitals arise from sideways overlap. This molecular orbital theory explains the bonding in molecules

$2s$ orbital will form, two molecular orbitals $\sigma2s$ and $\sigma * 2s$.
$2p$ orbital will form six molecular orbitals $\sigma2{p}_{z}$ and $\sigma * 2{p}_{z}$. $\pi2{p}_{x}, \pi2{p}_{y}$ and $\pi * 2{p}_{x}, \pi * 2{p}_{y}$

Hence the total number of molecular orbitals formed from $2s$ and $2p$ atomic orbitals of a diatomic molecule formed is $8$.

questions.q: The total number of anti bonding molecular orbitals, formed from $2s$ and $2p$ atomic orbitals in a diatomic molecule is _____________.
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The atomic orbitals combine to form a new set of equivalent orbitals known as hybrid orbitals. Unlike pure orbitals, hybrid orbitals are used in bond formation. The phenomenon is known as hybridisation, which can be defined as the process of intermixing of the orbitals of slightly different energies to redistribute their energies, resulting in the formation of a new set of orbitals of equivalent energies and shape.

The number of hybrid orbitals is equal to the number of atomic orbitals that get hybridised.

Antibonding molecular orbital from $2s = 1$ that is $\sigma * 2s$

Antibonding molecular orbital from $2p = 3$ that is $\sigma * 2{p}_{x}, \pi * 2{p}_{y}and\pi * 2{p}_{z}$.

Total $= 4$
